content: I recently joined and dont really know how things work! id appreciate some help and advice on which awakeners are good and bad

Hi! As the title mentions, I'm a new player. I started playing the game at the end of July, and I'm looking for advice on team building for D-Zone, since I've barely touched it.

Right now, my main team is Saya/Thais/Helot/Mouchette. For a second team, I was thinking about Gmurphy/Miryam/Tulu/Goliath, but I don't really know what to do for the other teams yet.

As for the 5 Origins of Time that I have, I'd like some advice on how I should use them. Aside from Helot, I don't really care about keeping my current standard characters. My main goal is to build strong teams to progress through the game, so I'm willing to use my Origins of Time on weaker characters with a lot of Enlightenment and basically replace them with stronger ones.

I was thinking of using them on Uvhash, Leigh, Agrippa (but i've seen that she can be a good support for Castor that i have  E3) and perhaps Alva, but I'm not totally sure, so any advice would be greatly appreciated!
thread_title: New player, team building and Origin of time use
